title: The End of Tourist Traps: The Impact of Review Platforms on Quality Upgrading
eligible_reason: Single-date design. The shock is the EU 'Roam Like at Home' abolition of roaming charges (post = date>=689, i.e. June 2017, identical for every restaurant in Rome). Treatment is tourist accessibility (tourist = probability>=.000651, a time-invariant above-median indicator, or att_100 = number of attractions in the zip code, a count) interacted with the common post date, estimated with reghdfe a(id date/year), pweights latt100_reviews_num, and post-interacted controls (distance to attraction, zip-code-by-year term, center-distance bins, restaurant characteristics x post). No unit-specific adoption dates, so not a staggered design. Event studies (Figures 1b, A3-A12) are relative to the same common date. Rating-group splits (lowq/midq/highq) and triple differences with rating x post are heterogeneity, not staggering.
design_notes: Stata 15. 0_Master.do runs 1_SyntheticDataGeneration.do, then Main_tables/Table_1-8, Main_tables/Table_A1-A19, Main_figures, OnlineAppendix_tables (Table_D1-D31). Main outcomes in Tables 2-4, 6-8 (log revenues, log employees, exit, hiring experience, salary, 5-month rating) come from INPS Social Security records merged to TripAdvisor restaurants; Table 5 is a zip-code-month panel of restaurant counts/shares with att_100_post (count of attractions x post). Figure 1b: reghdfe reviews_ t3_eu-t59_eu, a(date eu), EU vs non-EU reviewer counts around the June 2017 date.
data_provenance_note: README: Social Security (INPS) data are confidential and not included; 1_SyntheticDataGeneration.do builds synthetic_data.dta and synthetic_zipcode_data.dta from the published summary-statistics moments, and outputs 'do not reproduce the actual results'. Every main table (1-8) loads the synthetic files. Only TripAdvisor review data (restaurants_monthlypanel.dta, used in Figure 1a/1b) are original.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Not staggered: one common policy date. Would also fail on data provenance (main outcomes synthetic) and on post-interacted controls in every column.
